edges.claim: Coinbase Custody was custodian for 286.838M XRP held by Bitwise Trust at June30 2026.
Coinbase Inc provides Prime Execution Agent services; Trust-Directed Trade Model is the normal route.
Coinbase Credit may lend cash/XRP for trades on Coinbase; actual utilization and authorized amount are unknown.
Trading Balance secures repayment of Trade Credits and fees.
Trust XRP Account is collateral; default remedies can include liquidation of XRP.
Coinbase was the principal market for this Trust's GAAP XRP valuation at June30 2026.
H1 2026: 181.53M XRP additions, 25.61M redemptions and 0.305M sponsor-fee disposals.
Franklin identifies Coinbase Custody as XRP custodian.
Coinbase Inc is Franklin's Prime Broker.
Other custodians: BitGo and Anchorage; split undisclosed.
Anchorage is an additional custodian; split undisclosed.
Ripple Markets purchased 10M initial ETF shares for $220.676M on Dec20 2024; ETF-share lock-up applies.
H1 contributions 14.339M XRP, redemptions 41.459M, expenses 0.1825M; net -27.303M.
Those funds held 1.1422B XRP in aggregate at Oct30; actual Coinbase allocation unknown.

Cold-labelled and cbXRP reserve balances are not all customer tradable balances.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase actually holds 95.45% of all US spot XRP ETF XRP.
support: Five fund custodian sets include Coinbase; their aggregate holdings were 1.1422B XRP.
disconfirming: Multi-custodian allocations are not disclosed; 1.1422B is fund holdings, not Coinbase's custody balance.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain same-date custodian attestations or account-level allocations.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase Credit currently finances substantial XRP ETF purchases/sales.
support: SEC S-1 discloses cash/XRP trade credits and first-priority lien.
disconfirming: Agent Execution Model is rare; Trust-Directed Trade Model is normal; authorized amount and outstanding use undisclosed.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Search subsequent filings for drawdowns, balances, fees and amended credit limits.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase could liquidate Bitwise Trust XRP after an unpaid trade-credit default.
support: First-priority security interest and default remedies permit liquidation.
disconfirming: No default or current outstanding credit established; use described as rare.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Monitor default, credit balance and collateral disclosures.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Ripple's $220.676M seed investment was a direct spot XRP purchase.
support: Ripple Markets purchased 10M ETF shares; the ETF holds XRP.
disconfirming: The filing records an ETF-share purchase, not equivalent spot execution.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Trace fund cash/in-kind creations and Ripple Markets beneficial ownership separately.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The Dec20 2026 Ripple seed-share lock-up expiry will release XRP into the market.
support: A two-year ETF-share restriction date falls on Dec20 2026.
disconfirming: The locked asset is ETF shares, not XRP; redemption is not automatic; no sale intent disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Monitor beneficial ownership, ETF redemptions and actual XRP transfers after lock-up.

competing_hypotheses.statement: All ETF creations are new spot market purchases.
support: Cash creations can trigger XRP counterparty purchases.
disconfirming: In-kind creations transfer XRP directly; Bitwise Trust does not itself trade on digital-asset markets.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Separate cash and in-kind creation/redemption amounts in each issuer filing.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase is the principal market for all XRP ETF valuation.
support: Bitwise filing identifies Coinbase as principal market for its own NAV at June30.
disconfirming: The determination is fund-specific and can change.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The 133M seven-day exchange-wallet decline is caused by Binance and Coinbase outflows.
disconfirming: Binance +17.6M and Coinbase +17.7M over 7d; Kraken and Uphold account for the largest listed declines; no per-wallet history is stored.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain transaction-level wallet movements and reconcile untracked destinations.
